CONTRACT (read first). Repo Cognition-Partner-Workshops/otterworks, base branch tp-run/databricks-20260914T183234Z; one PR per unit into that branch, never main/tech-partnerships; PR bodies never name or email the requester. Read .migration/00_context.md, 01_conventions.md, 03_recon_tolerances.{md,json}, allowed_targets.json, docs/migration/P1_monthly_invoicing_analysis.md (your unit rows, dictionary, recon plan) and P1_monthly_invoicing_plan.md (decisions D2-1..D10-11 as DECIDED at STOP C). Never edit .migration/. Run factory-doctor --role child --expect-identity dhrov.subramanian@cognition.ai --expect-host https://dbc-8bc9474f-40ae.cloud.databricks.com --expect-catalogs ow_tp first; any mismatch -> report BLOCKED and stop. Skills: oracle-plsql, target-routing -> databricks-lakebase, data-reconciliation, tp-pre-pr-self-check. Oracle is read-only (secret name ORACLE_OW_BILLING_RO_DSN via AWS Secrets Manager ow-tp/oracle/ow_billing_ro; never print it); every live source read is pinned AS OF SCN and you get ONE live read per unit (2 statements). Lakebase: project ow-tp-billing, write ONLY to your batch branch below (create from its parent with TTL 7d; credential via `databricks postgres generate-database-credential`, PAT auth, unset DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET); never touch branch production. Databricks: catalog ow_tp only, serverless warehouse 565cd2fd713738c4, no clusters, everything prefixed ow_tp_, ns=demo. Fixture first (`make tp-smoke`, tp-validate-contracts, tp-validate-schemas), then one live dbx-recon run --mode transactional --target-kind lakebase --depth full; result.json on the PR is the merge authority (make tp-validate-recon). Caps: 3 review rounds, 3 full recon re-runs, then escalate. Report back: PR links, result.json paths, SCN pin, branch name, cost actuals.
BATCH w0-b1, unit U0 shared-core. Lakebase branch mig-p1-w0-b1 (parent: production, read it only as the branch source). Build schema ow_billing with sub-schemas util, plans, usage, rating, invoicing (empty except util) and roles ow_billing_app (owner), ow_billing_ro (reader). Port tables CODES, PLANS, TENANTS, BILLING_AUDIT_LOG with all PK/UK/NOT NULL constraints per the dictionary; sequence seq_billing_audit_log CACHE 1 + BEFORE INSERT trigger assigning log_id when NULL; PKG_OW_UTIL -> util.f_md5_uuid (md5(), same 8-4-4-4-12 formatting, upper/lower exactly as Oracle), util.f_code_desc (static lookup, 'UNKNOWN(<val>)' fallback), util.f_dt2str/f_str2dt ('DD-MON-YY', English, upper-cased month; f_str2dt returns NULL on parse error), util.log_msg in-transaction (D9-3), util.purge_audit_log() unscheduled port of JOB_PURGE_AUDIT_LOG (D5-1). Load the 4 tables from Oracle AS OF SCN (one pinned read), setval the sequence. Also create Delta ow_tp.silver.{codes,plans,tenants} (ns=demo) from the same pin and ow_tp.ops.p1_recon_runs (recon run log, schema from data-reconciliation skill). Scaffolding: write .migration/units/U0_shared_core/mapping_spec.json (watermark: none for codes/plans/tenants -> strict; billing_audit_log watermark logged_at, identity log_id) into your PR (units/ is yours; the rest of .migration/ is not), plus the thin python-oracledb source adapter for dbx-recon if the harness lacks one (D10-5) as a repo module under tools/. Recon tiers 1,2 (SUM(monthly_fee), SUM(overage_rate)),3 full diff,5,7; Tier 4: f_md5_uuid and f_code_desc parity on 50 fixed inputs vs Oracle. Declared source rows at pin: CODES 32, PLANS 3, TENANTS 69, BILLING_AUDIT_LOG 0 (re-read at your pin and record). Set REPLICA IDENTITY FULL on every table (Lakehouse Sync prerequisite, D10-9). One PR: ow_tp_u0_shared_core.
